<!-- README.md -->

# Appkit Core

Framework-free schemas, record contracts, storage and reviewed AI proposals for business applications.

## Why

Feature subpaths keep provider decisions visible while installation uses just two npm packages. Align schemas with validation and record operations; retain application control over data writes.

## Highlights

- `@alneas/appkit-core/storage`: [Store files behind explicit adapters](docs/storage.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/data`: [Align schemas and record operations](docs/data.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/japan`: [Apply Japanese regional defaults](docs/japan.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/graph`: [Calculate dependency plans](docs/graph.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/ai`: [Validate AI proposals before applying changes](docs/ai.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/us`: [Format US business data](docs/us.md).

## Quickstart

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

```typescript
import {sha256Hex} from '@alneas/appkit-core/storage';
console.log(sha256Hex('hello'));
```

## Next steps

[Public exports and optional peers](docs/exports.md) · [Contributing](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Releasing](../../RELEASING.md)

# Validate AI proposals before applying changes

## Prerequisites

Install the package; feature subpaths are import targets.

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

## Public import

`@alneas/appkit-core/ai`

## Step-by-Step Implementation

```typescript
import {createAjvValidator} from '@alneas/appkit-core/ai';
const validator = createAjvValidator({locale:'en'});
console.log(typeof validator);
```

## Verification

Type-check this example in your application. See [the export reference](exports.md) for narrower entry points and exact optional peers. Package import/type checks do not certify hosted providers.

## Troubleshooting / Common Pitfalls

Structured-output validation and proposal review contracts. Metadata checks do not prove that an AI coding agent can choose correct APIs from arbitrary requests. End-to-end coding-agent task evaluation remains unverified. Applications authorize and execute final writes.

# Align schemas and record operations

## Prerequisites

Install the package; feature subpaths are import targets.

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

## Public import

`@alneas/appkit-core/data`

## Step-by-Step Implementation

```typescript
import type {DataAccessAdapter} from '@alneas/appkit-core/data';
export function records(adapter: DataAccessAdapter) {
  return adapter.find('records', {});
}
```

## Verification

Type-check this example in your application. See [the export reference](exports.md) for narrower entry points and exact optional peers. Package import/type checks do not certify hosted providers.

## Troubleshooting / Common Pitfalls

Generic schema validation and CRUD contracts. The application owns authorization, migrations, transactions, final writes and durable idempotency. Use explicit feature subpaths for optional database SDK adapters.

## Provider-specific imports

| Feature import | Additional peer |
| --- | --- |
| `@alneas/appkit-core/data/supabase` | `@supabase/supabase-js` |
| `@alneas/appkit-core/data/neon` | `@neondatabase/serverless` |
| `@alneas/appkit-core/data/excel/excelize` | `excelize-wasm`; configure its WASM runtime explicitly |
| `@alneas/appkit-core/data/schema/introspection` | `pg` |

Install the additional peer separately from the Appkit package. These adapters do not supply credentials, migrations or backend authorization. Local provider scenarios were exercised in the earlier package layout; the consolidated distribution has separate import/type/consumer checks. Hosted-provider compatibility requires provider-specific evidence.

## Optional peers

Install an optional peer only when using its feature. Core entry loading does not certify a hosted backend.

| Peer | Version | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@supabase/supabase-js` | `^2.116.0` | No; feature-specific |
| `@neondatabase/serverless` | `^1.0.0` | No; feature-specific |
| `excelize-wasm` | `0.1.3` | No; feature-specific |
| `pg` | `^8.20.0` | No; feature-specific |
| `hono` | `^4.12.3` | No; feature-specific |

# Calculate dependency plans

## Prerequisites

Install the package; feature subpaths are import targets.

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

## Public import

`@alneas/appkit-core/graph`

## Step-by-Step Implementation

```typescript
import * as graph from '@alneas/appkit-core/graph';
console.log(Object.keys(graph).length > 0);
```

## Verification

Type-check this example in your application. See [the export reference](exports.md) for narrower entry points and exact optional peers. Package import/type checks do not certify hosted providers.

## Troubleshooting / Common Pitfalls

Framework-free dependency graphs, critical paths and planning helpers. Calculations do not persist schedules or authorize changes. Supply application-specific calendars and resource policies.

# Appkit Core

Framework-free schemas, record contracts, storage and reviewed AI proposals for business applications.

## Why

Feature subpaths keep provider decisions visible while installation uses just two npm packages. Align schemas with validation and record operations; retain application control over data writes.

## Highlights

- `@alneas/appkit-core/storage`: [Store files behind explicit adapters](storage.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/data`: [Align schemas and record operations](data.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/japan`: [Apply Japanese regional defaults](japan.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/graph`: [Calculate dependency plans](graph.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/ai`: [Validate AI proposals before applying changes](ai.md).
- `@alneas/appkit-core/us`: [Format US business data](us.md).

## Quickstart

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

```typescript
import {sha256Hex} from '@alneas/appkit-core/storage';
console.log(sha256Hex('hello'));
```

## Next steps

[Public exports and optional peers](exports.md) · [Contributing](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Releasing](../../../RELEASING.md)

# Apply Japanese regional defaults

## Prerequisites

Install the package; feature subpaths are import targets.

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

## Public import

`@alneas/appkit-core/japan`

## Step-by-Step Implementation

```typescript
import {japaneseHolidayCalendar} from '@alneas/appkit-core/japan';
console.log(japaneseHolidayCalendar({year:2026, month:1, day:1}));
```

## Verification

Type-check this example in your application. See [the export reference](exports.md) for narrower entry points and exact optional peers. Package import/type checks do not certify hosted providers.

## Troubleshooting / Common Pitfalls

Japanese calendar, formatting and business-document presets. Tests do not certify legal or tax compliance; review the applicable rules and date range.

# Store files behind explicit adapters

## Prerequisites

Install the package; feature subpaths are import targets.

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

## Public import

`@alneas/appkit-core/storage`

## Step-by-Step Implementation

```typescript
import {sha256Hex} from '@alneas/appkit-core/storage';
console.log(sha256Hex('hello'));
```

## Verification

Type-check this example in your application. See [the export reference](exports.md) for narrower entry points and exact optional peers. Package import/type checks do not certify hosted providers.

## Troubleshooting / Common Pitfalls

Web-standard signing, hashing, ZIP and object-storage adapters. Applications configure endpoints and credential flows. The storage implementation uses no native crypto dependency; the complete npm package has other dependencies.

# Format US business data

## Prerequisites

Install the package; feature subpaths are import targets.

```bash
bun add @alneas/appkit-core
```

## Public import

`@alneas/appkit-core/us`

## Step-by-Step Implementation

```typescript
import {formatUSD} from '@alneas/appkit-core/us';
console.log(formatUSD(1234.5));
```

## Verification

Type-check this example in your application. See [the export reference](exports.md) for narrower entry points and exact optional peers. Package import/type checks do not certify hosted providers.

## Troubleshooting / Common Pitfalls

USD formatting, federal holiday policy and English document presets. Select time zones and observed-holiday policy explicitly; formatting is not a tax determination.
